versions.subject: feat: new rule `amsi.dll load by uncommon process` (#4102)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\amsi.dll'
filter_windows:
    - Image:
        - 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\Sysmon64.exe'
    - Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
        - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
filter_program_files:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
filter_defender:
    Image|startswith: 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Platform\'
    Image|endswith: '\MsMpEng.exe'
filter_dotnet:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework\'
        - 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\'
    Image|endswith: '\ngentask.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\amsi.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe", "C:\\Windows\\Sysmon64.exe") OR Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*", "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*") OR Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*") OR (Image="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*" Image="*\\MsMpEng.exe") OR (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\*", "C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\*") Image="*\\ngentask.exe"))
